title: Harold Dejan refuses a drink at gunpoint
summary: Harold tells how a man threatened to shoot him for not drinking at a dance in Mississippi, while the band got drunk.

story.theme_name: Drink, drugs and the bandstand's casualties
story.community_name: Drugs and drink on the bandstand and the road
